Icha wal tz'aj yalchaj chi', icha chi' tze k'ulej. Malaj wal jab'ok tas tze k'exa'.

Palta tato ay mach tzek' t'a yib'anh, skomon b'o'an t'a yol yiko', manh ichok ix aj yalan heb' sacerdote ay yopisio yuj Dios, mato max sk'anab'ajej pax tas ix yal winh juez, ha jun chi' tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun pital tz'och t'a tas syal heb' yajal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' chonhab', ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Ayik ayexxo och t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ayik toxo ix heyak' ganar heyik'an lu'um, kajan hexxo ta', talaj tze komon alej icha tik: Kak'ekoch junok ko reyal ol ak'an yajalil t'ayonh, icha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a ko lak'anil tik. Tato ol heyal icha chi',
ha junok ketchonhab' ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol heyak'och he reyalok. Manhok junok ch'ok chonhab'il ol heyak'och he reyalok, yujto manh ketchonhab'ok.

Palta ha jun rey chi', mokab' tzijtumok nok' schej smolb'ej, mokab' schekb'at heb' winak t'a Egipto yik sb'at heb' yik'kot jantakok nok' chej ta', yujto ha Jehová alannakkani to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex b'atxi t'a Egipto chi'.
Mokab' tzijtumok tz'aj heb' ix yetb'eyum, yik max juwi'el t'a yichanh Jehová yuj heb' ix. Mokab' ste molb'ej k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata.
Ayik tz'och jun rey chi' t'a yopisio, schek tz'ib'chajelta scopia'il juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, haton juntzanh ayek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote yinhtilalkan Leví.

Yowalil yet'naknhej scopia'il jun sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, sk'ayb'an t'a junjun k'u, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol sat, ay pax yelk'och jun k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a yol sat, sb'eyb'alan tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il tik.
Yik wach' max sna'paxi to niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab', max yik'el sb'a t'a juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová tik. Icha chi' ol aj snajtilax yopisio yet' yinhtilal t'a he kal.

Ha heb' sacerdote yinhtilalkan Leví yet' masanil heb' yetlevita'il heb', malaj smakb'en lum heb' ol yik'a', icha juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal. Ha juntzanh silab' snhusjitz'a t'a Jehová ol schi heb', ma ol swa heb' yik ol ek' tiempo yuj heb'. Ha tas yik Jehová, ha chi' yik heb'.
Manh ol scha slu'um heb' icha yik juntzanh heb' ketchonhab', yujto ha tas yik Jehová, ha ayoch smakb'enok heb', icha ajnak yalan Jehová.
Ha tas yiktaxon heb' sacerdote t'a nok' wakax yet' t'a nok' kalnel syak' heb' anima silab'il, haton juntzanh tik: Sjenhjab' nok', sb'ak'chil sti' nok' yet' spimal stzukutz nok'.
Yik pax heb' yaj ixim b'ab'el trigo, b'ab'el wino, b'ab'el aceite yet' nok' b'ab'el lana tz'el t'a nok' kalnel ayik sjoxchaj nok'.
Yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ix sik'anel heb' yinhtilal Leví t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo kinhtilal, yik syak' serwil Jehová heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tato ay junok levita t'a he kal, te ay snib'ej sb'at t'a jun lugar ix sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok yik b'at munlaj ta',
syal smunlaji. Lajan tz'aj icha heb' yetlevita'il smunlaj ta',
scha'an swa'el icha yik heb' chi', wach'chom ay tas ay t'ay.
Ayik ayexxo'ek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' anima kajan ta'.
Malajokab' junok hex tze nhustz'a heyuninal silab'il. Malajokab' junok hex tzeyak' chum, ma tze na'anel tastak ol ujok, ma ajb'a'alil,
ma tze k'uman spixan heb' chamnak heyalani.

Yujto ha masanil heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chukal chi', te aykot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh heb'. Yujto yuj juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' ol satjokel heb' t'a heyichanh yuj Jehová chi'.
Yowalil te wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' ol heyikej chi', syak'och sk'o'ol heb' tas syal heb' ajchum yet' t'a heb' ajb'a'al. Ha hexxo jun, max schalaj sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal tato icha chi' tze k'ulej.
Ha ko Diosal chi' ol sik'anel junok ketchonhab' tik schekab'ok, icha ix yutej hin sik'anel ha hin tik. Yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej tas ol yala'.

Haton tik he k'annak t'a Jehová ko Diosal ayik ayonh ek' t'a lum witz Horeb, t'a jun k'u ha molan honh ek' ta', heyalan icha tik: Manhxalaj ko gana skab' sjaj Jehová ko Diosal chi', ma kilan jun niwan k'ak' chi', yik wach' max honh chami, xe chi.
Yuj chi' yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach' tas ix yal heb' anima chi'.
Ol wik'cha'anh junok hin chekab' t'a he kal icha hach tik, junok heyetchonhab'. Ha' hin ol wak' yojtakejel tas ol yala', ol yalan t'ayex masanil tas ol wal chi'.
Ha mach max cha'an yab' tas ol hin chek yal jun hin chekab' chi', yowalil ol wak' yowalil t'ay, yujto ha jun hin chekab' chi' ol lolon hin k'exulok.
Haxo pax mach syaloch sb'a hin chekab'ok, palta malaj tas swal t'ay, ma jun, schekab' junokxo komon Dios, ha jun chi' yowalil schami, xchikan Jehová chi'.
Palta tato ha hex tik ol he na'a: ¿Tas wal ol aj kojtakaneli tato manhok Jehová schekan yal jun chekab' chi'? tato xe chi.
Tato max elk'och tas syal jun syesejoch sb'a schekab'ok Jehová chi', snachajel heyu'uj to manhok Jehová tz'ak'an yala', anhej t'a yol yik snak'e'i. Yuj chi' manh hex xiw t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix satel masanil juntzanh anima yuj Jehová ko Diosal, toxo ix heyikej schonhab' heb', slu'um heb' yet' spat heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chi' ol he sik'el oxe'ok chonhab' haton juntzanh ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal heyikok.

Oxe' makan ol aj he pojan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhaltak yol junjun makan lu'um chi', hata' skan junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ol he b'o'an sb'e'al juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik wach' yalnhej mach smak'ancham junok yetanima'il, syal sb'at skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Anhej mach smak'ancham junok anima, tato manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', hata' b'at skol sb'a, yik wach' max chami.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh sb'at k'atzitz, tato ay junok heb' winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab', swa k'e'en t'a junxo winh chi', scham winh, ha winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab' chi' syal sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

K'inalok junnhej chonhab', najat sb'at sb'e'al, ay smay syamchaj winh yuj junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', smak'ancham winh chi' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, palta manh smojok scham winh, yujto toxonton manh yajk'olok sb'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze sik'kanel oxe'ok chonhab' b'aj syal skolan sb'a anima.

Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej juntzanh cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex, yujto tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak' lum lum chi' Jehová smasanil t'ayex, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik ol lewanb'ok lum he lu'um chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ol he sik'anel oxe'okxo chonhab' stz'akub'ok oxe' chekelxo yaj chi', haton b'aj syal he kolan he b'a.
Icha chi' ol he k'ulej, yik wach' manh komonok ol cham junok anima malaj smul t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, yik wach' max kotkan t'a heyib'anh yuj heb' anima scham chi'.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh toxon yajk'o'ol sb'a, ha junok winh smaklan yek' junxo winh chi' yik smak'ancham winh, ayik smak'ancham winh chi' winh, sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Tato icha chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil schonhab' winh ix cham chi', ha heb' winh schekanb'at yamchaj winh ix sb'at skol sb'a chi' ta', tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a schonhab' yik tz'ak'ji'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', yik smak'jipaxcham winh.
Manh heyak' niwank'olal jun anima chi', yik wach' max kan schamel junok anima malaj smul t'a heyib'anh, yik wach' ol aj heyelk'ochi.
Ha t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, manh he k'ex stz'akanhil he lum aykanem yuj he mam heyicham yik tze tok'an ek' yik junokxo mach ay yik t'a stitak heyiko'.
Tato junnhej testigo t'a spatik junok anima tz'och smul, max yal-laj yoch t'a yib'anh. Masanto ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och t'a yib'anh jun ay smul chi'.
K'inalok ay junok chuk spensar syik'cha'anh junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok mach yik syik'ankot t'a yib'anh.
Tato icha chi', yowalil tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová, haton t'a yichanh heb' sacerdote yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio.
Ha heb' ayoch yajalil chi', ha heb' sch'olb'itani tato yel jun lolonel chi', mato es syik'cha'anh jun anima t'a spatik junxo chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun tz'esan chi', hata' tz'ochkan jantak tas ix snib'ej yak'och t'a yib'anh junxo anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwi jun esalwumal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' anima, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Mokab' ok' he k'o'ol t'a junok esalwum chi'. Icha wal tas snib'ej t'a spatik yetanima'il chi', icha chi' tz'utaji. Tato snib'ej to smak'jicham jun yetanima'il chi', ma tz'ik'ji'elta yol sat, ma smak'ji'el ye, ma xikji'el sk'ab', ma yok, icha wal snib'ej tz'utaj jun anima chi', icha chi' tz'utaji.

Ayik tzex b'at owal, manh hex xiw t'a heb' heyajk'o'ol chi. Wach'chom tzeyila' to ek'to sb'isul heb' t'ayex, niwanpax sb'isul nok' schej heb' yet' scarruaje heb' yik owal yet' soldado heb', manh hex xiwok yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ik'jinak honh elta t'a Egipto, ha' ol och heyet'ok.
Ayik manto k'och yora'il yoch owal chi', ha winh sacerdote tz'alan t'a heb' soldado icha tik:
Ab'ek hex wetchonhab', ha tikne'ik toxo ol heyak' owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol, manh hex xiwok. Manh hex ib'xokk'e yuj xiwelal,
yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok. Ha ol ak'an owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol chi', yuj chi' ol kak' ganar heb', xcham winh.

Slajwi chi', syalan heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: Tato ay junok hex toto ix he b'ok'e he pat, manto hex ochlaj t'a yo'ol, meltzajanhek, k'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach skajnajkan t'a yol he pat chi'.
Tato ay pax junok mach t'a ko kal tik ix yawej yuwa, manta jab'ok sat smolo', meltzajokab' t'a spat. K'inalok scham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach smolan sat yuwa chi'.
Tato ay junok hex ayxo he trato he nupnaji, palta manto hex nupnajok, meltzajanhek yik tzex nupnaji. K'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxopax mach snupnaj yet' ix ix chi', xcham heb'.
Slajwi chi' syalanpax heb' yajalil soldado chi': Tato ayex tzex xiwi, meltzajanhek t'a he pat, yik wach' malaj heb' schab'axk'e sk'o'ol heyu'uj, xcham heb'.
Ayik slajwi slolon masanil heb' yajal chi', tz'ak'ji'och yopisio junjun kuchb'um t'a junjun makan heb' soldado.
Tato tzex k'och t'a spatiktak junok chonhab' yik tzeyak'an owal yet'ok, b'ab'el tzeyala': ¿He gana am junk'olal, mato owal? xe chi.
Tato ha heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' snib'ej junk'olal, tzex scha'anoch heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi', yowalil tzeyak' pural heb' yochkan he chekab'ok.
Palta tato malaj snib'ej heb' yoch junk'olal heyet'ok jun, tato syal heb': Kak'ek owal, tato xchi heb', tzex oymaj t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi', tzeyak'an owal.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he xikancham masanil heb' winh winak.

Haxonhej heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', heyik tz'ajkani. Tzex tzalaj yet' masanil tastak ol scha sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal yik skan t'a yol he k'ab', haton masanil tas ol heyik' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ichanhej chi' ol he k'ulej yet' juntzanh nación najat ay b'aj ol hex kajnaj chi'.
Palta ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal heyikej, manhxa junok anima tzeyaktejkani.
Ol he satel juntzanh heb' tik: Eb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová.

Icha chi' tzeyutej heb', yik wach' max hex sk'ayb'ej heb' he b'eyb'alan juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej ayik syak'anem sb'a heb' t'a diosal. Tato tze k'ulej tas sk'ulej heb' chi', tz'och he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato niwan tiempo tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak junok chonhab', manh he ch'akel te te' sloji sat, yujto ol he lo sat te'. Ha te' awb'en te' chi', manh anima'ok te', max yal-laj skot te' t'ayex yak' owal heyet'ok.
Ha pax te' komon te' max loji sat jun, tze ch'akel te' yik tz'och te' he tek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', masanto satel jun chonhab' chi' heyu'uj.
Tato tz'ilchaj sniwanil junok anima t'a spatiktakel he chonhab' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal heyikej chi', manh chekelok mach ix mak'anchamok,
ha heb' winh juez yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil jun chamnak chi', ha heb' tz'echtani mach junok juntzanh chonhab' chi' lak'an ay b'aj ix cham jun anima chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi', ha heb' winh tz'ik'anb'at junok nok' kob'es wakax manta b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'ay,
syik'anem nok' heb' winh t'a sch'olanil sti' junok ha' melem b'aj mantalaj mach smunlaji. Hata' smak'ji kanhchaj sjaj nok' wakax chi'.

Haxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'och testigo'al t'ay, yujto anhej heb' sb'o'an yaj owal yet' tastak chukal tzuji t'a skal he chonhab', haton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayoch heb' yak'an serwil yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'.
Slajwi chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' sb'ikel sk'ab' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' kob'es wakax chamnakxo chi',
syalan juntzanh lolonel heb' icha tik: Ha honh tik, manhok honh ix ko mak'cham jun anima tik, manh kojtakok mach ix mak'anchamok.

Mamin Jehová, ak' niwank'olal t'a kib'anh, mokab' ak'kanoch schamel jun anima tik ko mulok ha honh ha chonhab' honh kolb'il honh tik hu'uj, xcham heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj schamel jun chamnak chi'.
Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' t'a jun chamnak chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová.
Ayik tzeyak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'o'ol, tato tzeyak' ganar heb' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyik'ankot heb' he chekab'ok.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal tz'ilanoch junok ix ix te wach' yilji t'a skal heb', skan snib'ej t'a ix, syik'anb'at ix t'a spat,
hata' sjoxel xil sjolom ix, syik'anel yech ix,
sk'exchajel spichul ix ayochi ayik ix ik'jikot ix chi', skannhej ix t'a spat winh winak chi'. Jun ujal tz'ok' ix yuj smam snun. Slajwi chi', syik'an ix winh yetb'eyumok.
Tato slajwi chi', manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal yak'anel ix winh t'a libre. Palta max yal-laj schonhji'el ix, ma yoch ix schekab'ok winh, yujto toxo ix ixtaj ix yuj winh.

K'inalok ay junok winh winak chawanh yetb'eyum, jun ix te xajan yuj winh, haxo junxo ix chakb'ilel yuj winh. Tato tz'alji yune' heb' ix schawanhil, tato ha jun ix chakb'ilel chi' sb'ab'laj alji yune',

ayik sk'och sk'uhal spojanek' stastak winh, syak'an winh t'a heb' yuninal, max yal-laj yoch yune' ix xajanab'il chi' b'ab'el uninal. K'inalok icha b'ab'el unin syutej winh, chuk sk'ulej winh t'a winh sb'ab'el unin yik ix chakb'ilel chi', yujto ha winh chi' yel b'ab'el unin yaj winh.
Yowalil ha winh chi' b'ab'el unin yaji. Ha winh scha'an cha makan smakb'en yik sb'ab'el uninab'il.
Tato ay mach ay junok yuninal te chuk, ma te pit, max sk'anab'ajej tas syal smam snun, wach'chom smak'ji, palta hanheja' max sk'anab'ajej.
Tato icha chi', ha heb' mamab'il nunab'il chi', yowalil syik'b'at jun yune' heb' chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab',
syalan heb' icha tik: Ha wal jun kune' tik, te pit, te chuk. Max honh sk'anab'ajej, haxonhej chukal sk'ulej, te b'uk'tzin, anhej uk'el anh syak'a', xcham heb'.

Tato icha chi', haxo masanil heb' winh winak t'a jun chonhab' chi' sjulk'enancham jun yune' heb' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'ji'el jantak chukal ay t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, sxiwk'e heb'.
Tato ay junok winak smak'jicham yuj schukal, sk'e lokan t'a junok te te',

ha sniwanil chi', max kanlaj ta' tzek' ak'wal, yowalil smukchaj t'a jun k'u chi', yik wach' max heyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, yujto aykot skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh mach sk'e lokan t'a junok te te' chi'.
Tato ay junok hex tzeyil satkan nok' swakax, ma skalnel junok heb' heyetchonhab', manh tonhejok tzeyilkan nok', palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a jun heyetchonhab' chi'.

Tato manhok t'a he lak'anil kajan jun ay yik nok' chi', mato manh heyojtakok mach ay yik nok', tzeyik'kot nok', wach'okab' tz'aj nok' t'a he pat chi' masanto sayji'ek' nok' yuj winh yajal nok' chi', ichato chi' tzeyak'an meltzaj nok' t'a winh.
Icha pax chi' tze k'ulej yet' junok nok' b'uru, ma junok k'apak k'apak, ma junok yalnhej tas satb'ati. Tato ay junok hex tzeyila', mokab' tonhejok tzeyilkani.
Tato ay junok hex tzeyil stelwi nok' sb'uru, ma nok' swakax junok heyetchonhab' t'a yoltak b'e, mokab' tonhejok tzeyiloch heb', palta to tzex och yet' heb' heyik'ank'e wa'an nok'.

Ha heb' ix ix, max yal-laj sk'anan tastak sk'an heb' winh winak heb' ix, hanheja' heb' winh winak max yalpaxlaj yak'anoch spichul heb' ix ix heb' winh, yujto syajji mach icha chi' sk'ulej yuj Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato ay junok mach hex tzeyil junok so' nok' much t'a yol b'e t'a sk'ab' junok te te', mato sat lu'um ayemi, ayoch nok' snun chi' t'a yib'anh yune', ma t'a yib'anh snholob', manh heyik'b'at nok' snun chi' yet' yune' chi'.
Syal heyik'anb'at nok' yune' chi', haxo nok' snun chi' tzeyaktejkanb'at nok' yik wach' ol hex elk'ochok, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.
Tato ay junok hex tze b'ok'e junok he pat, panhan tz'aj yib'anh, tzeyak'ek' hoyan stitak t'a yib'anh chi' yik wach' malaj mach skot sutnajok, schami, yik max kot t'a heyib'anh.
Manh heyawej juntzanhokxo tas t'a skal b'aj awab'il heyuwa, talaj tz'ak'ji yowalil t'ayex, haxo tz'aji malaj junok makan schaji he lo sat.
Ayik tzex munlaj yet' arado, manh heyak'och te' yugo t'a junok nok' wakax yet' t'a junok nok' b'uru yik junnhej smunlaj nok' schawanhil.
Manh heyak'och pichul jalb'il t'a nok' lana yet' lino.
Tze b'o'och chanhe'ok schional yelwanub'ok schikintak he xotil.
Tato ay junok winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix yetb'eyumok, haxo tz'aji maxtzak xajanej ix winh,
syalan winh to ay smul ix, sna'ank'e lolonel winh t'a spatik ix, syalan winh: Ix wik' jun ix ix tik, haxo ix hin way yet' ix, ix wilani to manhxo kob'esoklaj ix, xchi winh.
Tato icha chi', haxo smam snun ix kob'es chi' tz'ik'anb'at yechel yik skob'esal ix t'a yichanh sdespacho heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab'.
Syalan winh smam ix chi' icha tik t'a heb' winh: Ix wak' ix wisil yetb'eyumok jun winh tik. Haxo tikne'ik manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix,

tzijtum tas syal winh. Tob' ay smul ix. Syalan winh to manhxo kob'esok ix, palta ina wal sch'oxnab'il skob'esal ix tik, xchi winh smam ix chi'. Ayik wan yalan winh icha chi', sch'oxan jun sábana winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi'.
Haxo heb' winh syaman winh winak chi', smak'an winh heb' winh t'a nok' tz'u'um.

Slajwi chi' syak'an cien siclo k'e'en plata winh smulta'ok, yujto syesejk'e winh t'a spatik jun ix kob'es israel, syalan winh to ayxo smul ix. Ha jun tumin chi' tz'ak'ji t'a winh smam ix kob'es chi'. Manh yujok chi' maxtzak yik' ix winh, palta yowalil syik'nhej ix winh masanto chamel.
Palta tato yel ha junok ix ix chi' manhxo kob'esok ix ayik ix nupnaj ix, malaj yechel t'a ix,

tz'ik'ji'el ix t'a sti' spat smam, sjulk'enajcham ix yuj masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yak'och jun niwan mul ix t'a he kal, syak'anpax k'ixwelal smam ix. Icha chi' tz'aj satel juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum, tz'ilchajelta heb', scham heb' schawanhil, icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok ix kob'es ayxo strato snupnaji, haxo tz'aji ay junokxo winak tz'ixtan ix t'a yol junok chonhab',

tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh despacho t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' sjulk'enajcham heb' schawanhil. Scham ix yujto maj el yaw ix yik ay mach skolani. Schampax winh winak chi' yujto ix yixtej jun ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyumok jun winh yetwinakil winh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay junok ix ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyum, schalan sb'a ix yet' junok winh winak b'aj malaj anima, tz'ixtaj ix yuj winh, tato icha chi', anhej winh winak chi' schami yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh.
Haxo ix kob'es chi', malaj tas tz'alchaj t'a ix, yujto malaj smul ix, max yal-laj scham ix. Ha jun tas sk'ulej winh winak chi' lajan icha junok winh smak'cham junok yetanima'il,
yujto sch'okoj ix ayek' b'aj malaj anima. Wach'chom tz'el yaw ix, palta malaj mach skolan ix.
Tato ay junok winh winak schalaj sb'a yet' junok ix kob'es mantalaj mach ay strato yet'ok, syak'an pural winh yixtan ix, tz'ilchajelta heb',
ha winh winak chi' yowalil syak' 50 siclo k'e'en plata winh t'a winh smam ix, yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh. Yowalil syik'xonhej ix winh yetb'eyumok, masanto chamel.
Malajokab' junok mach tz'em ajmulal yet' ix yetb'eyum smam. Tato ay mach sk'ulan icha chi', malaj yelk'och smam t'a yol sat syal chi'.
Tato ay mach mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en, ma ik'b'ilel swinakil chi', max yal-laj yoch t'a skal heb' yetisraelal ayik molanek' heb' yik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Hanheja' junok mitz' unin, malaj pax yalan yik yoch t'a skal heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová. Hanhejtona' pax yinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh max yalpaxlaj yochi.
Ha heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita, jun'elnhej malaj yalan yik heb' yoch t'a skal b'aj molanek' heb' schonhab' Jehová, ma yinhtilal heb' t'a b'ak'inh.

Yujto ayik ix honh ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en heb', ayik ix honh elta t'a Egipto, maj yak'laj jab'ok ha' heb' kuk'ej, maj yak'paxlaj jab'ok ko wa'el heb'. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb' to ix stup winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor heb', ix kot winh t'a Petor t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, yik tzul honh skatab'ankan winh.

Haxo Jehová ko Diosal, maj schalaj yab' tas ix yal winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' ha katab' ijan ix yalkan winh chi' t'a kib'anh, wach' lolonel ix aj yalankan winh, yujto te xajan honh yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' jun'elnhej malajokab' b'ak'inh tzex och t'a junk'olal yet' heb'. Manh he b'opax tas yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Palta haxo pax heb' edomita, manh he patikejkanel heb', yujto ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' heb'. Manh he patikejpaxel heb' aj Egipto, yujto ek'nak honh kajan jun pekti' t'a yol smakb'en heb'.
Hato heb' yixchikin heb' ayxo yalan yik yoch t'a ko kal b'aj sko molb'ej ko b'a yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Ayik tzex b'at t'a owal yet' heb' heyajk'o'ol, ayik ayex ek' ta', manh he k'ulej tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Tato ay junok winh winak tz'el yinhatil ayik waynak, yowalil tz'elkan winh t'a spatiktak campamento tzek' k'u.
Haxo t'a yemk'uhalil, wach' syutej winh sb'ikanel sb'a, haxo yik sk'ik'b'i, tz'ochxikan winh t'a yol campamento chi'.
Yowalil junnhej junok b'aj t'a spatikel campamento b'aj tzex tzaji.
Ayik tzex b'at tzajel, tzeyik'b'at junok te te' t'a yol he pa, pach yaj snhi' te', tze joy junok olan, tzex tzaji'em t'a yo'ol. Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ankank'e lum lum t'a yib'anh.

Yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ajun heyet'ok, yiknhej yaj jun campamento chi'. Ha tzex tanhwani, skolwajpax heyet'ok yik tzeyak'an ganar heb' heyajk'o'ol chi'. Max yal-laj to ay tas chuklaj ay t'a he kal chi', talaj tz'el Jehová chi' t'a he kal yuj jun chi'.
Tato ay junok chekab' tz'el elelal t'a spatrón, snib'ej tz'aj heyet'ok, manh heyak' meltzaj t'a spatrón chi'.
Kanokab' heyet'ok. Libre sik'lan junok chonhab' b'aj snib'ej tz'aji. Malajokab' mach stzuntzani.
Malajokab' junok winh winak, ma junok ix ix t'a ko kal syak'och sb'a ajmulal yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha k'e'en tumin syak' ganar junok ix ix, ma junok winh winak t'a spatik yajmulal, manh he cha yak' k'e'en heb' b'aj syak' sti' yak'an t'a Jehová, yujto ha jun b'eyb'al chi' te chakb'ilel yuj.
Ayik tzeyak'an k'e'en tumin majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'an yune' k'e'en, ma yalnhej tastak, manh he k'an smajananub'al.

Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal syal he k'anan smajananub'al junok tas tzeyak' smajnej. Haxo t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'ana', yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heyib'anh t'a sat lum lum ol heyikej chi'.
Ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, elanhchamel tze k'anab'ajej, yujto ol sk'anb'ej Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tato max heyak'a' tz'och he mul.
Tato malaj b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová chi' jun, malaj b'aj syal yoch he mul.
Tato ay b'aj tzeyak' he ti' heyak'an jun, yowalil tzeyak'elk'ochi, icha wal tas tz'el t'a he k'o'ol.
Ayik tzex och t'a skal smunlajel junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he lo'an sat yuwa icha jantak snib'ej he k'o'ol he lo'ani, palta max yal-laj heyik'anb'at jab'ok t'a yol he pa.
Tato tzex och t'a skal strigo junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he k'utzanelta ixim sjolom he k'uxu', palta max yal-laj tze jochelta ixim yet' k'e'en jochlab' trigo yik tzeyik'anb'ati.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik'laj sb'a yet' junok ix ix, haxo tzek' jab'ok tiempo, ay tas syab' winh t'a spatik ix, manhxalaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal spukan sb'a heb', palta yowalil syak' yumal yik puklajb'a'il winh t'a ix, slajwi chi' tz'elta ix t'a yol spat winh chi'.
Ayik toxo ix spuk sb'a ix yet' winh, syal yik'an junokxo winak ix.
Palta tato ha junxo winh syik' ix chi' schami, mato tonhej manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syak'anpax yumal yik puklajb'a'il winh t'a ix, spechanelta ix winh t'a yol spat,
maxtzak yal-laj yik'an ix winh b'ab'el yetb'eyum chi', yujto manh wach'ok tato syik'xi ix winh. Chukxo t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal. Yuj chi' manh heyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' heyikej.

Tato ay junok winh winak toto ix och yetb'eyum, max yal-laj sb'at winh t'a owal. Max yalpaxlaj yoch winh t'a junok opisio. Jun ab'il libre tz'ajkan winh t'a spat yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smajnan tumin t'ayex, manh he k'anek' smolino, ma scha' yuj smajananub'alok. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ichato tzeyamoch wa'an swa'i.
Tato tz'ab'chaji to ay junok winh israel tz'elk'anb'at junok yetchonhab' yik tz'och schekab'ok, ma yik schonhaneli, yowalil scham jun winh elk'um anima chi', tz'el jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay mach b'aj spitzwicha'anh jun yab'il skuchan lepra, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sleyal jun yab'il chi', icha tz'aj yalan heb' sacerdote, haton juntzanh ix walkan t'ayex.
Na'ekkoti tas sk'ulejnak ix María t'a yol b'e yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayik kelnakkot t'a Egipto.
Tato ay k'e'en tumin tzeyak' smajnej junok heyetanima'il, manh hex och t'a yol spat tzeyik'anelta junok tas yik skan smajananub'alok k'e'en.
Palta to tzex kan t'a sti' spat, tze tanhwan yik'kanelta tas ol yak' smajananub'alok k'e'en chi' t'ayex.
Tato te meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix heyak' k'e'en tumin chi' majanil, tato ha sk'apak aykan smajananub'alok k'e'en, manh heyamkan wanaj t'ay yik tzek' ak'wal.

Ayik sk'ik'b'i tzeyak'an meltzajok, k'inalok malaj tas sk'u'ej tzek' ak'wal. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej, ha jun anima chi' ol yal wach' lolonel t'a heyib'anh, wach' pax tzex kan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal.
Manh heyixtej heb' meb'a' smunlaj t'ayex, heb' heyetchonhab', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze tup heb' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Tze tup heb' he majan t'a junjun yemk'uhalil, yujto yowalil sman heb' tas swa t'a jun k'u chi'. Tato ma'ay, syal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo yoch he mul t'a Jehová chi'.
Max yal-laj scham heb' mamab'il nunab'il yuj smul yuninal. Hanheja' heb' uninab'il chi', max yalpaxlaj scham heb' yuj smul smam snun chi'.
Manh he k'ulej tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ma t'a heb' manhxa smam. Manh he k'anek' sk'apak heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum yuj smajananub'alok junok tas smajnej.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal heyu'uj to ek'nak honh chekab'ok t'a Egipto, haxo Jehová ko Diosal honh ik'anelta ta'. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik.

Tato ayik wan he jochan ixim he trigo, sat he k'o'ol skan junok manoja ixim t'a he patik, manhxo hex meltzaj heyik'kot ixim. Kanokab' ixim ta', yik ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' heb' manhxa smam, ma heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, ha heb' ol ek' sik'an ixim, yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a heyib'anh yet' masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Ayik tze b'ixan sat te' heyolivo yet' te heyuwa, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molanel sat te' t'a sk'ab'. Ha te' skan chi', manhxo hex meltzaj he molel te'. Yikxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yaji.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal heyu'uj to ha hex tik ek'nak hex chekab'ok t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.
Tato ay chawanhok anima syak' owal, yowalil sb'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, yik sb'o yaj yowal heb' chi'.
Tato ha winh ay smul chi' smoj smak'ji, syalan winh juez to tzek' jichan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh. Smak'ji winh ay smul chi' icha jantak smul chi'.
Ayik smak'ji winh chi', max yal-laj yek' t'a yib'anh 40 tz'u'um tz'och t'a winh. Tato tzek' t'a yib'anh, manhxalaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat anima syab'i.
Manh heyak'och spa'il sti' nok' nok' stek'wi trigo.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak yuktak sb'a, junnhej patil b'aj ay heb' winh, haxo tz'aji scham junok winh, mantalaj yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum. Ha ix yetb'eyum winh chi', max yal-laj yik'an junokxo ch'ok winakil ix. Palta ha winh yuktak winh yetb'eyum ix ix cham chi', ha winh tz'ik'anxikan ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajan sleyal winh yuj ix smu' chi'.
Ha sb'ab'el unin heb' sjawi, ha sb'i winh yetb'eyum ix chamnak chi' tz'och t'ay, yik wach' max satel sb'i winh t'a skal ko chonhab'.

Palta tato malaj snib'ej winh syik' ix smu' chi' jun, syal sb'at ix t'a yichanh heb' juez yet' t'a yichanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', syalan ix icha tik: Ha winh hin mu' malaj snib'ej winh sb'inajkan winh yuktak t'a skal ko chonhab'. Max stak'laj winh wik'an hin b'a yet'ok icha t'a sleyal, tato xchi ix.
Slajwi chi' tz'awtaj winh yuj heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh. Tato max yal sk'o'ol winh syik' ix smu' chi',

sk'och ix t'a stz'ey winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', syik'anel junok xanhab' winh ix, stzub'anpax och ix t'a sat winh, syalan ix: Icha tik tz'utaj heb' winh malaj snib'ej syak'kan b'inaj yuktak, xcham ix.
Yuj chi', ha tz'aj sb'inaj yinhtilal winh smu' ix chi' t'a skal ko chonhab', “yinhtil winh ik'b'ilel xanhab'”, xcham heb' anima.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak wan yak'an owal, sjawi ix yetb'eyum junok winh yik skolan winh yetb'eyum ix chi' sna'ani, tato ha swinakil winh wan smak'lan sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum ix chi' syamchaj yuj ix, stok'ankot winh ix,
tato icha chi', manhxalaj niwank'olal, xikji'el sk'ab' ix.
Manh he k'an echlab' manh tz'akanok ayik tzex chonhwaji, ma ayik tzex manwaji,
palta to ha wal echlab' tz'akan, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
yujto malaj snib'ej ko Diosal chi' t'a heb' max b'eyb'alan tojolal.
Na'ekkoti, tas honh yutej heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Amalec ayik ayonhek' t'a yoltak b'e ayik toxo honh elta t'a Egipto.
Tze na'anpaxkoti to malaj jab'ok xiwk'olal heb' t'a Dios. Ha heb' ketisraelal najat tzak'anto skot ku'uj yuj k'unb'elal, ix laj miljikancham heb' yuj heb' aj Amalec chi'.

Yuj chi' ayik ol hex koljokel yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a heb' ajk'o'ol oyanoch t'a spatiktak lum lum ol ak'jok heyikej chi', yowalil tze satel heb' yinhtil Amalec chi', manhxo ol b'inaj heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a jun'elnhej. Mokab' b'at satk'olal jun cheknab'il tik heyu'uj.
Ayik kajan hexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
ayik tze molan b'ab'el sat heyawb'en t'a lu'um, tzeyik'anb'at t'a yol junok mo'och t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok.

Hata' tzex k'och t'a yichanh heb' winh ayoch sacerdote'al t'a jun pekti' chi', tzeyalan icha tik: Ha tikne'ik, skal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal to kajan honhxo t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote scha'anek' jun mo'och tzeyik'b'at chi', syak'anoch winh t'a yichanh altar.

Slajwi chi' tzeyalan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Ha heb' ko mam kicham, arameo heb', jaywannhej sb'ey heb' yek'nak heb'. Ha yek'nak heb' chi', tonhej sb'eyek' heb' t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' snok'. Ijan chamnak heb' yuj wejel, yuj chi' b'atnak heb' t'a Egipto yet' jaywanh yuninal. Hata' ochnak heb' chonhab'il, manhxo jantakok ajnak sb'isul heb', te ay smay heb'.
Palta te ilb'ajk'o'ol utajnak heb' yuj heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yilnak wal syahelal heb' ayik yak'jinakoch heb' t'a munlajel te ya.

Yuj chi', yalnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham to skolwaj yet' heb'. Yab'nak Jehová chi' tas yalnak heb', yilannakpax munlajel te ya b'aj ayoch heb' chi'. Ilb'ajk'o'ol utajnak heb' b'aj ayoch chekab'wumal.
Sch'oxannak spoder Dios to ayxo smay yilji, ayik yik'annak elta heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Satub'tak yilji tas sch'oxnak, laj xiwnak heb' aj Egipto chi' yuj.
Honh yik'ankot t'a sat jun lum lum te yax sat tik.

Yuj chi' jun, tik skik'kot b'ab'el sat kawb'en t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, xe chi. Slajwi heyalan juntzanh lolonel chi', tzeyak'anoch te' mo'och chi' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, tzex em kuman t'a yichanh.
Slajwi chi' tzex tzalaj wal yet' heyal heyuninal yuj masanil tas ix yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tzeyawtan kot heb' levita yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Ha t'a junjun yoxil ab'il, tzeyak'an sdiezmo'al masanil tas tzeyik' t'a tastak tzeyawej. Tzeyak'an t'a heb' levita, t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' t'a heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' t'a he kal.

Junjunex tzeyal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Toxo ix wik'kanel t'a hin pat masanil tas to ik yaji, haton t'a tas ix wik' t'a hin munlajel t'a sat lum lum tik. Toxo ix wik'paxel yik heb' levita yet' yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a ko kal, heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Toxo ix hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala', malaj junok ha cheknab'il tik sb'at satk'olal wu'uj. Malaj junok to max hin k'anab'ajej.

Malaj wal jab'ok juntzanh chi' ix hin wa t'a sk'uhal ayik ayin och t'a kusk'olal yuj chamel yet' t'a sk'uhal manh wach'ok waj icha yalan ley. Maj waltejoch t'a heb' chamnak. Ix hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala'.

Ilonhemta t'a satcha'anh, t'a lugar to ik yaji, ak' ha wach'k'olal t'a kib'anh ha honh ha chonhab' Israel honh tik yet' t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ix ak' t'ayonh b'aj kajan honh tik, icha ajnak ak'an ha ti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix halan masanil juntzanh cheknab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej yet' he b'eyb'alani. Tze k'anab'ajej t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar.
Toxo ix heyal tikne'ik to ha Jehová he Diosal yaji. Ix heyak'an he ti' he k'anab'ajani, he b'eyb'alan scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il.
Haxo pax Jehová tz'alani to ha honh israel honh tik, schonhab'onhxo icha ajnak yalankani, yuj chi' yowalil sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il.

Ha Jehová chi' ol hex ak'anoch t'a niwak chonhab'il, ol hex b'inaj t'a wach'il, niwan ol aj heyelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación sb'onak. Schonhab' hex paxi, sik'b'ilexpaxel yuj, icha ix aj yalani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix halan juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil heb' chonhab': Ha tikne'ik, ol he k'anab'ajej masanil tas skalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik ol hex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán yik ol hex och t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, tze b'okank'e juntzanh k'e'en niwak k'e'en t'a yich lum witz Ebal, tzeyak'anoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a k'e'en. Tze tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swalkan tik t'ayex t'a k'e'en. Tze k'ulej jun tik ayik ayexxo'ek' ta'.

Tze b'o'anpaxk'e junok altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ha k'e'en k'e'en tzeyak'och chi' t'ay, manh he mak'poj k'e'en, manh he tzeypax tojolb'ok k'e'en. Ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' tze nhustz'a silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Tzeyak'anpax silab' sch'oxan he junk'olal yet' ko Diosal chi'. Hata' tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

B'at ta satk'olal heyu'uj he tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex t'a juntzanh k'e'en b'aj ol heyak'och k'e'en ta'anh chi'. Te wach' tzeyutej he tz'ib'ankanochi yik chekel, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Moisés, ajun heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví yet'nak winh, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: Hex wetisraelal, numan tzex aji, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha tikne'ik toxo honh och wal schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová swalkanel tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'u chi' ix yalpax jun cheknab'il tik winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi':
Ayik toxo hex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, ha heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, Leví, Judá, Isacar, José yet' Benjamín, tz'aj heb' t'a yich witz Gerizim, yik syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Gad, Aser, Zabulón, Dan yet' Neftalí, tz'aj heb' t'a yich lum witz Ebal yik syalan katab' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Leví, te cha'anh syal juntzanh lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal icha tik:

katab'il mach sb'o'an junok yechel komon Dios t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, syak'anoch t'a junok lugar k'ub'eltak yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay. Ha juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach malaj yelk'och smam snun t'a yol sat, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach sk'exan stz'akanhil slu'um yik stok'ek' slu'um junokxo mach, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach tz'ak'an musansatil junok anima max ujilaj yilani, haxo t'a ch'ok b'e'al schekkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.

katab'il mach sk'ulan tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, t'a heb' unin manhxa smam, ma t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, yujto ha mach sk'ulan icha chi', syak' k'ixwelal smam chi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' nok' nok', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' schab'il yanab', yanab' yuj smam ma yuj snun, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix snhi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smak'ancham junok yetanima'il t'a elk'altak, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach scha'an tumin yik smak'ancham junok anima malaj smul, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach max k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
Tato yel tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal swalkan tik t'ayex, te niwan ol aj heyelk'och yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hanhejtona' tato tze k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal, ol he chapax masanil juntzanh yaxilal ol wal tik:
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' heyuninal, t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, t'a yib'anh yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas ol heyak'em t'a yol he mo'och yet' t'a yib'anh tas tze wa'a.
Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh b'ajtak tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch heb' heyajk'o'ol t'a yol he k'ab' ayik ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok. T'a stzolal ol aj skot heb' t'ayex, palta sakleminak ol aj yel heb' elelal t'ayex.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' te tzalajk'olal ol hex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová chi', tze b'eyb'alani, ol hex yalnhejoch schonhab'ok to sik'b'ilex el yuj, icha ajnak yalani.
Haxo heb' anima t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to sik'b'il hex el yuj Jehová, ol xiw heb' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol hex xajananok: Tzijtum ol aj heyuninal yet' yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', jantak ol aj sat heyawb'en t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayex.

Ol yak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik t'a stiempo'al, icha jantak tz'och yopisio. Te wach'xonhej ol aj he munlajel. Masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ol te k'ib'cha'anh, masanto ol yal heyak'an majanil t'a tzijtumok nación. Ha hexxo pax tik, malaj tas ol he k'an he majnej t'a junokxo mach.

Tato ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, haton masanil juntzanh swalkan t'ayex tikne'ik, sat ol hex aj t'a heb' ch'ok nacional chi', haxo heb' spatiktak ol ajkan heb'. Niwan ol aj heyelk'och t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj b'aj ol hex ak'jok ganar yuj heb'.
Icha chi' ol hex ajok, tato max heyik'el he b'a t'a spatik scheknab'il Jehová, tato max hex och tzak'an t'a spatik komon Dios, yik tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex, ol ja wal juntzanh katab' tik t'a heyib'anh:
Te chuk heyik t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Syalelk'ochi to malaj tas ol heyik' t'a he munlajel chi', malaj pax tas ol he wa'a.
Ol jawok yahelal t'a yib'anh heb' heyuninal, malaj swach'il ol aj sat heyawb'en. Manh ol k'ib' yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel, yune' nok' he chiwa yet' masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Chuk heyik b'ajtaknhej tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ol yak'kot yahelal Jehová yet' ilk'olal t'a heyib'anh. Toxonhej ol hex somchajel t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej. Elanhchamel ol hex satel yuj chukal tze k'ulej yuj heyaktankan Jehová chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot juntzanh ilya te ow t'a heyib'anh, masanto ol hex satel t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol hex kajnaj chi'.

Ol yak'paxkot yab'il yab'il Jehová chi' to ol hex cham yuj, k'ak'al ilya te chuk yet' he malk'e'i. Haxo heyawb'en ol takjokelok. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', takinh ol aj smasanil. Ol och tz'a'ub' t'a he munlajel masanto ol yal he sateli.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol kot t'a satcha'anh. Manhxo ol yak'laj sat heyawb'en t'a lum lum chi'.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol yak'a'. Haxonhej lum pokok yet' k'e'en arena ol em yuj Jehová ko Diosal, masanto ol hex satelok.

Ha Jehová chi' ol hex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' heyajk'o'ol. T'a stzolal ol aj he b'at t'a owal, haxo ol ajok, sakleminak ol aj heyel t'a heb'. Ol sat sk'o'ol masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol hex ik'anok.
Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol chi'anb'at he niwanil. Manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan nok' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová ol ak'an k'ab'at he niwanil yuj mal yab'il, icha wal ajnak heb' aj Egipto. Ol k'epax kisk'oy t'ayex yet' yaxk'a yet' k'ilaj yab'il, manhxalaj yanhal juntzanh ilya chi'.
Ol hex kistalaxok, ol somchajel he k'o'ol, manhxo ol yal-laj heyilani.

Toxonhej ol hex ek' machmon t'a chimk'uhalil, icha tz'aj yek' machmon heb' max ujitaxon yilani. Haxo t'a masanil tas ol he k'ulej, manhxalaj tas ol elk'och t'a wach'il. Ol hex te ixtaxelok. Ilb'ajk'olxonhej ol hex ajok. Manhxalaj mach ol hex kolanok.
Ha mach ol sb'o strato snupnaj yet' junok ix ix, ch'okxo mach ol way yet' ix. Ol he b'ok'e junok he pat, palta manhxo ol hex kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Ol heyawej junok heyuwa, palta manhxo ol he lo sat.

T'a wal heyichanh ol smilcham nok' he wakax heb' ajk'o'ol, palta manh ol he chi' jab'ok schib'ejal nok'. T'a heyichanh ol yik'b'at nok' he b'uru heb', manhxo ol yak' meltzaj nok' heb' t'ayex. Ol yik'b'at nok' he kalnel heb', manhxalaj mach ol yal skolankan nok' t'a heb'.
Heyichanh wal ol b'atkan heb' heyuninal yet' heb' ix heyisil t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol hex k'unb'ok he maklan sjax heb', palta manhxa jab'ok tas syal heyu'uj.
Ha heb' anima manh heyojtakok, ha heb' ol satanel masanil sat heyawb'en yet' jantak he munlajel. Ol hex ixtaj wal, ob'iltakxonhej ol hex ajok.
Ayik ol heyilan masanil juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol hex kistalaxkanok.
Ol yak' wal kot yahelal Jehová t'a heyib'anh, ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom he penek, t'a he xub' yet' t'a masanil he niwanil. Manhxo ol anhtaj jun ilya chi' heyu'uj.

Ol hex ik'jokb'at yuj Jehová chi' yet' he reyal sik'b'iloch heyu'uj t'a junok nación to manh heyojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' he mam heyicham. Hata' ol heyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Ol sat sk'o'ol juntzanhxo nación yab'an tas ol hex utajok. Ol aljok he pekal, ol hex b'uchjok yuj juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ol hex yik'b'at Jehová chi'.
Te niwan inhat ol heyawej, palta jab'nhej sat ol he molo', anhej nok' k'ulub' ol k'uxanb'atok.
Ol heyawej heyuwa, ol he mesani, palta manh ol he b'ixlaj sat, malaj wino ol heyuk'ej, anhej nok' yaxtaj ol lajanelok.
Ay te' olivo t'a sat he lu'um, palta malaj yaceite'al te' ol he k'ana' yujto tonhej ol k'ajb'anel sat te'.
Ay heyuninal, ay heyisil, palta manh ol ajlaj heb' heyet'ok, yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación.
Masanil te te' syak' sat t'a he chonhab', pilan ol lajwokel te' yuj nok' k'ulub'.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, niwanxo ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a heyichanh, ha hexxo tik, manhxalaj ol aj heyelk'ochi yujto ol hex lajwokemok.
Ha heb' chi', ay tas ol yal yak'an heb' majanil, palta ha hexxo tik, manhxalaj tas t'ayex. Ha heb' sat ol aj t'ayex, ha hexxo tik spatiktakil ol hex ajkanok.
Masanil juntzanh yahelal tik ol ja t'a heyib'anh. Ol heyab'xonhej sya'il masanto ol yal he sateli, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal ix yak' t'ayex.
Ha juntzanh yahelal tik sch'oxkot yowal sk'o'ol Dios t'ayex yet' t'a heb' heyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto maj heyak'em he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol ayik ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh,

yuj chi' yowalil ol heyak' serwil heb' ajk'o'ol ol yak'kot t'ayex, ol heyab' sya'il wejel, takinhti'al, manh pichulal yet' masanil yahelal. Ol heyab' wal sya'il yuj heb' heyajk'o'ol chi' masanto ol yal he sateli.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nación te najat b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ha heb' ol yik'kot Jehová t'ayex, yelk'olal ol aj skot heb' icha sjenhwi nok' ch'akb'a. Ch'ok ti'al syal heb', manh ol heyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Te owal anima heb'. Malaj yelk'och heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin t'a heb'.

Ol schib'at yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' heb', ol slo'anb'at sat heyawb'en te' heb', masanto ol hex ixtajwal. Manhxalaj he trigo, he wino, heyaceite, ma yune' nok' he wakax yet' yune' nok' he kalnel ol to kan yuj heb', anhej to ol hex cham yuj wejel.

Ol och hoyan heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a spatiktak he chonhab'. Ol jawok heb' t'ayex masanto ol yal yem lanhnaj smuro'al he chonhab' cha'anh yajk'e'i yet' b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado ayoch yipok he k'o'ol. Masanil juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ol laj yoymitej heb'.

Ayik ol laj oymaj heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a he chonhab' chi', haxo yuj wejel ol he chi'anb'at heyuninal yet' heyisil ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal. Wach'chom ay junok winak t'a he kal te wach' syutej sb'a, palta yuj wejel chi' ol schib'at yuninal. Manh ol yak' jab'ok t'a yuktak, t'a ix yetb'eyum to xajan yuj yet' t'a juntzanhxo yuninal olto kanok.

Wach'chom ay junok ix ix manh komonok syutej sb'a t'a he kal, te b'eyum ix, malaj b'aj tz'em yok ix t'a sat lu'um, aynhejoch xanhab' ix, palta yujto manhxa tas swa ix yuj b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a spatiktak he chonhab' chi', ol schib'at yune' ix toto tz'alji yet' smoj yune' chi'. Manh ol yak' jab'ok ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, ma t'a juntzanhxo yune'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal te wach', te ay smay, palta tato malaj yelk'och t'ayex, manh ol he b'eyb'alejpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik,
ol yak' wal kot niwak yahelal ko Diosal chi' t'a heyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heyinhtilal. Ha wal ilya te chuk ol yak' t'a heyib'anh to manhxalaj yanhal.
Ol kot wal juntzanh ilya t'a heyib'anh, icha wal juntzanh ilya ik'annak heb' aj Egipto, haton juntzanh b'aj te xiwnak hex. Manhxo ol el-laj juntzanh yahelal chi' t'a heyib'anh.
Ayto juntzanhxo yahelal max b'inajlaj t'a juntzanh slolonel Dios tik ol jawok t'a heyib'anh yik tzex sateli.

Ha hex wal tik hex wetisraelal, te niwanxo he b'isul, lajan hexxo icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh, palta ol hex satelok. Manhxo niwanok ol ajkan he b'isul, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal.

Icha ix aj stzalaj sk'o'ol sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ix yak'an k'ib' ko b'isul, icha pax chi' ol aj stzalaj sk'o'ol yuj he sateli. Elanhchamel ol aj hex yik'anxi'el t'a lum lum b'aj toxo ol hex kajnaj tik.

Ha hex olto hex kanok, ha Jehová ol hex saklemankanb'at b'ajtak slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hata' ol hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton komon Dios b'aj max heyak'em he b'a, manh yak'nakokpaxem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'ay.

Ayik ayex ek' t'a juntzanh nación chi', manh ol heyik' jab'ok heyip, malaj jab'ok tas b'aj ay heyalan heyiko'. Yujto t'a xiwk'olal ol hex ajek' yuj Jehová ta', kuseltakxonhej ol aj yilji he sat yuj ilk'olal.
Xiwk'olal ol hex ajek' t'a masanil tiempo yuj he chamel. Ol hex te xiw t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil.
Ol hex te xiw wal sik'lab'il yuj juntzanh te ay smay ol heyila'. Ha t'a k'inhib'alil ol heyala': Tzok wal k'ik'b'i, xe chama. Haxo t'ak'walil ol heyalanxi: Tzok sakb'i, xe chama.

Wach'chom ix yal Jehová to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex meltzaj t'a Egipto, palta ha ol hex ak'anxib'at ta' t'a yol barco. Hata' ol he chonhoch he b'a schekab'ok heb' heyajk'o'ol chi', palta manhxalaj mach ol hex mananok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.

Ha juntzanh lolonel yik trato ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol smakb'en Moab. Stz'akub' sb'a juntzanh tik yet' trato ix sb'o Jehová yet' heb' t'a lum witz Horeb.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ha hex tik, heyilnak wal tas utajnak winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' masanil smakb'en Egipto chi' yuj Jehová.
Testigo heyaj t'a juntzanh yahelal yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová chi'.
Palta masanto tikne'ik maxto yak'laj heyojtakejeli tas syalelk'och juntzanh chi'.
40 ab'il ix hex hin kuchb'ej t'a takinh lu'um. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', maj lajwokel-laj he pichul, maj lajwokel-laj he xanhab'.
Maj he walaj ixim pan, maj heyuk'laj wino, ma yal sat te' awb'en te' pajb'inak, yik wach' snachajel heyu'uj to ha Jehová haton ko Diosal.
Ayik ix honh jawi t'a jun lugar tik, ix elta winhaj Sehón sreyal Hesbón yak' owal ket'ok yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán, palta ix kak' ganar heb'.
Ix kik'ankan slu'um heb', ix kak'an t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan jun trato tik, yik wach'nhej ol aj heyelk'och t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej.
Ha tikne'ik, tik wal molan honh ek' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal. Masanil heb' yajal t'a heyinhtilal, heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', heb' ay yopisio yet' masanil heb' ketisraelal:
Eb' winh winak, heb' unin, heb' ix ix yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a ko kal, haton heb' k'atzitzwum yet' heb' kuchum ha',
molan honh ek'i yik wach' sko chakan strato Jehová ko Diosal b'aj syak'kan sti' t'ayonh.

Ha wal tikne'ik scheklajkaneli to tzonh ochkan schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal, haxo tz'ochkan ko Diosalok, icha yutejnak yak'an sti' t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, haton heb' ko mam kicham.
Manhoknhej ket' ha honh molan honh ek' tik sb'o jun trato tik Jehová chi',
palta yet' pax heb' kinhtilal toto ol aljok.
Ha hex tik heyojtak wal sik'lab'il tas wal aj kek'nak t'a Egipto yet' tas ajnak ko k'axpajek'ta t'a yol smakb'en juntzanh nación t'a yoltak b'e.
Hata' kilnak juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh yechel nab'a te', nab'a k'e'en, nab'a plata yet' nab'a oro, te chuklaj sk'ulej juntzanh anima chi', ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Komonok malaj junok anima t'a ko kal tik, winak, ma ix, ma junok yinhtilal heb' ketchonhab' tz'aktankan Jehová ko Diosal, haxo t'a sdiosal juntzanh nación chi' tz'och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' sk'ulej, lajan icha junok yib' te' swolani, ha swol chi' te k'a', scham anima yuj.

Tato ay junok mach t'a ko kal tik te nhikan syutej sb'a sna'ani, slajwi yab'an tas tz'ajkan jun trato tik, syalan icha tik: Wach'chom tzin pitej hin b'a tzin k'ulan masanil tas snib'ej hin k'o'ol, palta malaj tas ol hin ik'anok, tato xchi, ol kot yahelal t'a kib'anh ko masanil wach'chom wach' honh, ma chuk honh.

Yuj chi' manhxo ol ak'joklaj niwank'olal jun anima chi' yuj Jehová, ha yowal sk'o'ol ol jawok t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'. Ha masanil juntzanh yahelal tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, ha' ol kot t'a yib'anh, ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal t'a sat lum lum tik yuj Jehová.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ik'anel jun anima chi' t'a skal masanil yinhtilal heb' ketisraelal, ol yak'anoch yahelal t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' masanil yahelal sb'inaj t'a trato b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan masanil ley, ol kot t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'.
Ha heb' heyinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh yet' juntzanhxo anima ch'ok chonhab'il ol kot t'a najat, ol yil wal yahelal heb' yet' ilya ol yak'kot Jehová t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ol yil heb' to ha lum lum chi' tz'anak lu'um smasanil, anhej k'e'en azufre yet' atz'am atz'am ay t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol yal yawchaj t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol k'ib' t'a lu'um, wach'chom anh ank'ultak manhxo ol k'ib'laj anh. Icha wal ajnak satel juntzanh chonhab' yuj yowal sk'o'ol Jehová, haton Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma yet' Zeboim, icha wal chi' ol aj lum he lu'um tik.
Yuj chi', masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol sk'anb'ej heb': ¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix yutej jun chonhab' chi' Jehová? ¿Tas yuj ix te kot wal yowal sk'o'ol t'a heb'? xcham heb' anima chi'.

Haxo ol laj spakan juntzanhxo heb': Icha chi' ix aj jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yaktejkan strato Jehová heb', haton trato sb'onak Jehová chi' yet' heb' smam yicham heb', ayik yik'jinakelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max yak'taxonem sb'a heb', manhok Jehová ix halan t'a heb' to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', ix kot masanil juntzanh katab' tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a strato t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix yik'el jun chonhab' chi' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, ix yak'ankanb'at heb' t'a skaltak juntzanhxo nación, ichaton wan yuji tikne'ik, xcham heb' ol pakan jun lolonel chi'.

Ay wal tas manh kojtakok, ha juntzanh chi', yik Jehová ko Diosal yaji. Palta ay tas ak'b'il kojtakejel yet' heb' kuninal, haton masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik yet' kachnab'il yik sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo.

Ayik ol ujok masanil juntzanh tas ix wal tik t'ayex, haton swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax skatab' yuj he patikaneli, palta tato ol sna'a sb'a he k'o'ol ayik ayexxo ek' t'a masanil nación b'aj ol hex yak'kanb'ati,
tato yet' smasanil he k'o'ol yet' pax smasanil he pensar tze k'anab'ajan yet' heb' heyuninal icha wal tz'aj walankan tik t'ayex,
ol sk'ex spensar ko Diosal chi', ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal t'ayex. Ol ok'pax sk'o'ol t'ayex, ol hex smolb'anxikot b'aj ix hex saklemkanb'at chi'.
Wach'chom hex saklemkanb'ati, ix laj hex k'ochkan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hato ta' ol hex yik'xikot Jehová ko Diosal chi'.
Ol hex smolb'anpax b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' ko mam kicham. Hata' ol hex ajxok. Ek'b'al niwan ol aj he b'eyumal yet' he b'isul yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh heb' ko mam kicham chi'.
Ol yak'och yechel strato Jehová t'a he pensar yet' t'a spensar heb' heyinhtilal yik ol he xajanej t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar yik wach' ol hex ajok.
Haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'anb'at masanil katab' tik t'a yib'anh heb' ajk'o'ol ix chichonoch sk'o'ol t'ayex, heb' hex ixtani.
Ha hexxo tik, ol hex meltzajxok t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.

Yuj chi', te b'eyum ol hex ajxok yuj Jehová chi', ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tastak tze k'ulej, t'a yib'anh heyuninal yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' t'a he munlajel. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas syal Jehová, masanil scheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, tato t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab', ol tzalaj sk'o'ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol yet' heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha juntzanh cheknab'il swak' heyojtakejel tik, manh ajaltakok ko k'anab'ajani, manh najatok ayel t'a ko tz'ey.

Manhok t'a satcha'anh ay, yik wach' max heyal icha tik: ¿Mach wal syal sk'ek'och t'a satcha'anh yik sb'at yik'anemta jun cheknab'il tik, syak'an kojtakejeli, yik wach' sko b'eyb'alej? max yal heyalan icha chi'.

Hanhejtona', manhokpax t'a sk'axepal ha' mar ay, yik max heyal icha tik: ¿Mach syal sk'axpajek' t'a ha' mar chi', yik sb'at yik'ankot t'ayonh, syak'an kojtakaneli sko b'eyb'alani? max yal heyalan icha chi'.
Okxo jun, ha jun cheknab'il tik ayek' t'a ko kal, skalub'tanhej, aypaxoch t'a ko pensar, yik wach' sko k'anab'ajej.
Ha tikne'ik, tik wal swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej: ¿Am k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato ha' katab' yet' chamel?

Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex, tze xajanan Jehová ko Diosal, tzex ochnhej tzak'an yuj, tze k'anab'ajan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, wach' ol hex ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul heyuninal. Ichato chi' ol yak'an syaxil Jehová ko Diosal t'a heyib'anh t'a sat lum lum b'aj wan heyoch tik yik tze makb'enej.
Tato max he cha heyab' juntzanh tik jun, palta to tze b'ek he b'a he montajb'at t'a spatik komon Dios, tzex em kuman t'ay,
tato icha chi', wal t'a jun rato tik swalkan t'ayex to ol hex chamok. Manhxo ol najtilax he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol heyikej chi' ayik ol hex k'axpajkanek' t'a ha' Jordán.

Wal t'a jun k'u tik swak'kanoch satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik testigo'al to swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej, am he k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato ha katab' yet' chamel. Palta sik'lejek he k 'inal, yik wach'nhej tzex aj yet' heb' heyinhtilal.

Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajej, manh heyaktejkani, yuj chi' ol he cha he k 'inal, najtil ol hex ek' t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel icha tik:
Ayxo 120 ab'il hin k 'inal, manhxa wal wip hin b'eyek' hex hin kuchb'ej, hanhejtona' toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to manhxo ol hin k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán tik.

Palta ha Jehová ol b'ab'lajnhej t'a heyichanh, ol satanel masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' b'aj ol hex k'och chi'. Ha hexxo ol hex kajnajkan t'a slu'um heb'. Haxo winhaj Josué ol hex kuchb'anok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol satanel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', icha ix aj satanel heb' winh sreyal amorreo, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og yet' heb' yetchonhab' heb'.
Ha ol ak'anoch juntzanh nación chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb' icha ix aj walan t'ayex.

Tek'b'ejek he b'a, manh hex xiwok ayik ol he chalan he b'a yet' heb' ajk'o'ol chi', yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. Manh he na' to ol hex aktajkan yuj, manh ol hex yak'kanlaj he ch'okoj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Josué chi' winh. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal ha b'a, manh hach xiwok, yujto ha hach ol ik'b'at jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ha hach ol ak'kan junjun makan heb' t'a smakb'en.
Ha Jehová ol b'ab'laj hu'uj. Aynhejek' het'ok, manh ol hach yaktejkanlaj, yuj chi' manh hach xiwok, manh hach meltzaj t'a ha patik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh.

Ix stz'ib'an juntzanh tik winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'ik'anb'at skaxa'il strato Jehová yet' t'a masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ayik slajwi yuktakil ab'il, t'a yol ab'il yik slajwikan b'ok, ayik molanek' masanil anima t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj t'a juntzanh sk'uhal k'inh chinama, hata' tz'awtaj ley tik yab' masanil anima.

Smolb'ej sb'a masanil anima, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze molb'ej he b'a yuj heyab'ani yet' heyojtakanel masanil tas syal jun ley tik, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat, yik tze k'anab'ajan tas syala'.

Icha pax chi' heb' heyinhtilal manto ojtannakok jun ley tik, ol yab'kan heb' yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová chi' t'a yol sat heb' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum lum ol heyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Wanxo sk'och stiempo'al yik ol hach chamok. Yuj chi' awtejkot winhaj Josué, tzex b'at t'a hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a yik wach' ol wak'kanoch yopisio winh, xchi t'a winh. Ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Josué chi'.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh t'a skal jun niwan asun ix och moyan t'a sti' kajnub' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha hach tik toxo ol hach chamok. Slajwi chi', ha jun chonhab' tik ol ochkan tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh yechel skomon diosal juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatik yichanh b'aj ol k'och heb'. Ol hin yaktejkan heb', ol yixtanb'at hin trato heb' ix hin b'o yet'ok.

Yuj chi', ol kot wowal t'a heb', ol waktankan heb' sch'okoj. Manhxo ol wab' tas ol yal heb'. Manhxo jantakok yahelal ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb', masanto ol yal heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj skab' sya'il? Yuj am to manhxo ayok ek' ko Diosal t'a ko kal, xcham heb'.
Ayik ol yab'an juntzanh yahelal chi' heb', ol wik'el hin b'a t'a skal heb' yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej, yuj pax to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ha tikne'ik jun, tz'ib'ejek jun b'it ol wal t'ayex, ol he k'ayb'an heb' heyetchonhab' Israel tik t'ay, ol sb'itan heb' yik swak'och testigo'al t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ol lajwok wik'anoch heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum te yax sat chi', lum wak'nak hin ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam heyicham, ol wa heb' sik'lab'il, ol b'ak'echb'ok heb'. Ol lajwok chi', ol b'at heb' t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ol hin spatikanel heb', ol yixtanb'at hin trato heb' hin b'onak yet'ok.

Ayik ol jawok jantak yahelal yet' ilk'olal t'a yib'anh heb', ha jun b'it tik ol ak'an testigo'al t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal heb' ol na'ankot jun b'it tik, ol sb'itan heb'. Yujto ayik manto ochlaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak hin ti' wak'an t'a heb', wojtakxo tas ayek' t'a spensar heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix stz'ib'ejkan jun b'it tik winhaj Moisés, ix yak'an winh sk'ayb'ej heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué, yuninal winhaj Nun icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal ha b'a, manh hach xiwok, yujto ayinnhej och het'ok. Ha hach ol ik' och heb' etisraelal tik t'a sat lum lum wak'nak hin ti' wak'an t'ayex, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi stz'ib'ankan masanil juntzanh ley chi' winhaj Moisés chi',
ix yalan winh t'a heb' yinhtil Leví et'jinak skaxa'il strato Jehová icha tik:
Ik'ekb'at jun tz'ib'ab'il tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a stz'ey skaxa'il strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik syak' testigo'al t'a heyib'anh.
Yujto wojtak to te pit hex, malaj he gana sk'exwi he pensar. Ayik ayinto ek' heyet'ok, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a, okxom wal ol hin chamok.
Awtejek heb' yichamtak winakil junjun heyinhtilal yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', yik swalankanel jun b'it tik t'a heb'. Swak'anoch satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigo'al.

Wojtakxo to ayik ol hin chamok ol heyixtankanb'at he b'a, ol heyaktankan jun b'e b'aj tzex wak'kanoch tik. Hanhejtona' wojtakxopaxi to ha t'a b'ak'inh, ol jawok yahelal t'a heyib'anh, yujto ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová yuj chukal ol he k'ulej t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' icha tik:
Yab'okab' satcha'anh hin loloni. Yab'okab'pax lum lum tas ol wala'.
Ha k'ayb'ub'al swal tik lajan wal icha yem nhab'. Ha lolonel swal tik lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'emi, hanheja' icha yem nhab' t'a yib'anh te te' yet' t'a yib'anh anh ank'ultak, icha chi' yaji.
Swalkaneli to niwan yelk'och Jehová. Ik'ekcha'anh sb'i ko Diosal.
Ha Jehová b'aj sko kol ko b'a lajan icha junok k'e'en niwan tenam. Te wach'nhej tas sb'o'o, te tojolnhej sb'eyb'al. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
Ha hex wetchonhab' hex tik, te manh he mojok tzex och yuninalok Jehová, te malaj he wach'il, te pit hex t'ay.

¿Tom yet' he pital chi' tzeyak' spak t'a Jehová? Ha hex tik malaj he pensar, malaj jab'ok he jelanil. ¿Tom manhok Jehová ko Mam yaj jun? ¿Tom manhok honh b'o'ani? Ha honh b'o'ani, honh yak'anoch t'a chonhab'il.
Na'ekkot tas sk'ulejnak Jehová, tze na'an t'a juntzanh tiempo ix ek'b'ati. k'anb'ejek heyab' t'a he mam he nun. Ab'ekpax tas syal heb' winh ichamtak winak.
Ayik ix pukaxkanb'at anima t'a junjun nación yuj Jehová Haxonhej Ochi, yuj yak'ankanem stz'akanhil slu'um junjun chonhab', t'a sb'ab'elal ix sna'a t'a jantak ko b'isul ha honh israel honh tik.
Ha honh yinhtilal honh winhaj Jacob ix honh sik'kanel Jehová yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Honh ilchajelta yuj t'a jun tzinan lu'um, b'aj te ow yek' ik'. Ix honh stanhwej wal, ix honh sya hilani, icha wal ko ya ilan snenal yol ko sat.
Icha tz'aj sjuanb'at so' nok' niwak ch'akb'a, sk'ayb'an yune' nok' yik sjenhwi, icha pax tz'aj yik'anb'at yune' nok' chi' t'a yib'anh sk'axil, icha wal chi' ix honh yutej Jehová.
Ha ix honh ik'ankoti, malaj junok komon Dios ix kolwaj yet'ok.

Ix laj yak'kan lum tzalkixtak kikej. Ha tas sk'ib'k'e t'a sat lu'um ix yak' kab'lej, ix yak'anpax nok' yalchab' tz'elta t'a yoltak k'e'en k'e'en t'ayonh yet' aceite tz'el t'a te' olivo sk'ib' t'a skaltak k'e'en k'e'en.

Te niwan yal yim nok' ko wakax yet' nok' chiwa ix elta, ix ko b'o'an queso t'ay. Ay nok' kelemtak kalnel ix ko chi'a. Ix ko chipax nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' nok' chiwa te b'ak'ech stanhwaj t'a Basán. Ha wal ixim trigo te wach' ix ko wa'a, ix kuk'an wino, haton yal sat te' uwa.
Hex wetchonhab', haxo yik ix hex b'ak'echb'i ha hex chonhab' Jesurún hex tik, ix heyik'anel he b'a t'a Jehová ix honh b'o'ani, ix he patikejkanel ko Kolumal chi'.
Ix he tzuntzej wal kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová, yujto ix hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh ch'ok diosal chakb'ilel yuj.

Ix heyak'an he silab' t'a juntzanh enemigo, juntzanh manh diosok, t'a juntzanh komon Dios manta b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a, juntzanh komon Dios toto sb'ojik'e'i, b'aj manh yak'nakok em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha hex wetisraelal hex tik, ix b'at satk'olal heyu'uj mach ix honh b'o'ani yet' ko Kolumal. Majxo he nakot ko Diosal ix honh ak'an pitzwok.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi', ix hex spatikejkanel ha hex yuninal hex tik.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Manhxo ol hin b'at k'elan t'a heb', ol wila' tas ol yutok sb'a heb'. Wal yel ha juntzanh anima tik te malaj swach'il heb', max yal-laj wak'anoch heb' yipok hin k'o'ol.

Ix stzuntzejkot wowal heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh diosok. Ix chichon hin k'o'ol t'a heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj yelk'och chi'. Wu'uj, ol tz'a sk'o'ol heb' yuj juntzanhxo chonhab' malaj yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', ol hin tzuntzejkot yowal heb' yuj tas ol wak' t'a juntzanhxo anima manto nachajel yuj.
Ix te kot wal yowal hin k'o'ol, icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'. Masanil tas ay t'a yich lum lum stz'akanb'at yuj, scha sk'ak'al lu'um masanto sk'och t'a yich niwak witz.
Ichato ol hin julb'at juntzanh jul-lab' t'a yib'anh heb', syalelk'ochi to ol wak'b'at masanil makanhil yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Haton juntzanh tik:
Wejel, k'ak'al ilya te ow, jun yahelal te ow satanel anima. Ol wak'anb'at nok' chi'um nok' t'a skal heb' yet' nok' chan te ow sveneno'al.
Ol laj cham yuninal heb' t'a yoltak calle yuj k'e'en espada. Xiwk'olalxonhej ol ajek' heb' t'a spat. Ol cham heb' kelemtak, heb' ix kob'estak, heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin tzato chuni.
Ix hin na' to ol hin saklemkanb'at heb' israel tik, ol hin satanel heb' t'a sat lum lum tik yik wach' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb'.

Palta malaj hin gana tzin sb'uch heb' ajk'o'ol, malaj hin gana syik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Talaj syal heb' icha tik: Ha honh wal ix ko satel heb' israel tik, manhok Jehová ix satanel heb', talaj xchi heb'.
Malaj jab'ok spensar heb' anima chi', max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Tato ay spensar heb', tzam nachajel yuj heb' tas ol elk'ochok.

¿Tas yuj ix el lemnaj mil heb' israel t'a junok heb' yajk'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj lajunhe' mil heb' ix el lemnaj t'a chawanhok heb'? Ha heb' ajk'o'ol chi' malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj heb', palta ha hin Jehová hin Skolumal hin heb' israel chi', ix wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' kajk'o'ol chi' yojtak heb' to ha sdiosal heb' skolani, max yal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Kolumal ha honh tik.
Ha heb' kajk'o'ol chi' stzalaj heb' yet' chukal icha schukal heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra. Haxo stzalajk'olal heb' chi' lajan icha veneno.
Ha swino heb' lajan icha sveneno'al sti' nok' chan, scham anima yuj, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil chukal ix sk'ulej heb' ajk'o'ol chi', na'annhej wu'uj, ichato tonhej sik'an wu'uj.

Ha hinnhej ay walan wik wak'anoch syahelal heb'. Ha hin ol wak' spak t'a heb' icha smoj scha'an heb'. Ay jun k'uhal ol satel heb', yujto lak'anxo sja sk'uhal. Jab'xonhej sk'och yora'il satel heb', xchi.

Ha Jehová ol och yet' heb' schonhab' ayik ol yilani to manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol ok' sk'o'ol Jehová chi' t'a heb' schekab', ayik ol yilani to manhxa junok mach syal skolwaji, manhxalaj heb' chekab', ma heb' yik sb'a.
Ichato chi' ol sk'anb'an Jehová t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi': ¿B'ajtil ay he diosal tikne'ik, juntzanh tzex kolani, haton juntzanh tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol,
juntzanh schi'anb'at xepu'al he silab' yet' yuk'an he wino tzeyak' t'ay silab'il? K'e'okab' wan he diosal chi' yik skolwaj heyet'ok. Kotokab'i yik tzex stanhwej.

Na'ekkoti to ha hinnhej Dios hin. Malaj junokxo Dios t'a wichanh. Ha hin swak'cham anima, ha hin pax swak'xi pitzwok heb'. Ha hin swak' echnaj heb' anima, swanhtanpax heb'. Malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a yol hin k'ab'.
Ha hin Jehová hin tik, ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo, swik'cha'anh hin k'ab' swak'an hin ti'

to ol hin b'o yaj jun owal tik. Icha junok snhikk'e ye k'e'en yespada toxonhej skopopi yik sb'at t'a owal, icha chi' ol hin k'ulej, yik ol hin b'at wak' spak t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol wak' syahelal heb' icha t'a smojal scha'an heb'.

Chik'takxonhej ol aj hin jul-lab' yuj schik'il heb'. Haxo wespada ol xikankanb'at schib'ejal heb' chamnak yet' pax heb' yamb'ilkot t'a owal. Haxo sjolom heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin chi', chik'takxonhej ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová chi'.

Hex anima t'a junjun nación, tzalajanhek yet' schonhab' Jehová, yujto ol spaktzitej schamel heb' schekab'. Ol satel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ol yak'an tup smul heb' schonhab' chi' t'a yib'anh. Ol sakb'itajxi slu'um heb' yuj Jehová, haton b'aj ix laj emkan schik'il heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix k'och winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh masanil chonhab' Israel, tzak'anoch winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winh, ix yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha tas ix wal tik t'ayex, na'annhejokab' heyu'uj t'a masanil tiempo. Hak'ekoch t'a he k'o'ol. k'ayb'ejek heb' heyuninal yik ol sk'anab'ajej jun ley tik heb' sik'lab'il.
Manh komon lolonelok juntzanh tik, palta to ay he k 'inal yuj. Tato tze k'anab'ajej smasanil, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol heyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
K'e'anh t'a lum switzal Abarim, tzach k'ek'och t'a sjolom lum switzal Nebo t'a yol lum yik heb' moabita, t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ol ilkanb'at lum Canaán ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Ha t'a sjolom jun lum witz b'aj ol hach k'e chi', hata' ol hach chamok, icha ix aj scham winh uktak aj Aarón t'a lum jolom witz Hor.
Yujto ix he tenek' tas ix wal t'ayex he chawanhil, maj hin heyik'cha'anh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel t'a ha ha' skuchan Meriba-cades, t'a takinh lum Zin.
Yuj chi' manhxo ol hach k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ix wak' hin ti' wak'an t'a heb' etchonhab' Israel, najatxonhej ol ilkanb'at lu'um, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik wan sk'och stiempo'al scham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová, ix och ijan winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Skot Jehová t'a lum witz Sinaí. Hato t'a Edom syak'kot sakil k'inal t'ayonh. Hato pax t'a lum witz Parán syak'kot kopan stzikiki'al. Skot yet' heb' yángel manhxo b'ischajb'enok. Ha t'a swach' k'ab' yet'nak ley, sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al.
Ha Jehová sxajanan heb' schonhab', stanhwej heb' yikxo. Ha heb' chi' tz'och ejmelal t'a yichanh, sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il heb'.
Ha jun ley swak'kan tik, ichato smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Jacob yaji.
Ha Jehová ayoch reyal t'a Jesurún, ayik smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab', ayik smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, xchi winh.

Ix syamanoch winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junjun inhtilal. Ix yalan winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Rubén icha tik: Aynhejokab' ek' heb' yinhtilal Rubén. Mokab' satel heb', mokab' kennhejok ol aj sb'isul heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Judá icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ab' tas syal heb' yinhtilal Judá. Ik' meltzaj heb' t'a schonhab', kolwajanh yet' ha poder yik syal stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajk'o'ol, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Leví icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ik k'e'en Tumim yet' k'e'en Urim, ix ak' k'e'en t'a winh sik'b'ilel hu'uj, haton winh ix ak' prowal t'a Masah, winh ix ha telaj ha b'a yet'ok t'a ha' Meriba.
Yelxo wal ix hach snib'ej heb' yinhtilal Leví chi' t'a yichanh smam snun, t'a yichanh yuktak, ma yuninal. Ha heb' chi' ix sk'anab'ajej ha cheknab'il heb', maj yixtejb'at ha trato heb' alb'ilkani.
Syak'nhej ha ley heb' sk'ayb'ej heb' yinhtilal Jacob. Syalannhej ha k'ayb'ub'al heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal. Snhusannhej incienso heb' t'a ichanh, snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a altar.

Mamin Jehová, ak' wal ha wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', scha'okab' ha k'o'ol yik syak'an yopisio heb' t'ayach. Tza satkanel heb' yajk'o'ol heb' yik wach' maxtzak k'e wan heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'a heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Benjamín icha tik: Te xajan heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yuj Jehová, t'a junk'olal ayek' heb'. Ha skolwaj yet' heb'. Ha ayoch stanhwumalok heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal José icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh slu'um heb' yinhtilal José. A'okab' yal ak'wal wach' tz'em t'a lu'um, ayokab' ha ha' sk'e'ul t'a sat lu'um.
Wach'okab' tz'aj sk'ib' sat tas tz'el t'a sat slu'um heb' t'a junjun ab'il, wach'okab'pax tz'aj sat te te' t'a junjun ujal.
Niwanokab' sat te' awb'en te' wach' tz'el t'a spak'ultak lum witz aytaxonek' t'a peka' smol heb'.

Wach'okab' tz'aj sat te' awb'en te' tz'el t'a sat slu'um heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, haton sch'oxnak sb'a t'a skal te' k'i'ix ayoch sk'ak'al. Kotokab'kan masanil juntzanh wach'k'olal tik t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal José, haton winh sik'b'ilel t'a skal heb' yuktak.

Te ay smay heb' yinhtilal José, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín manhxo b'ischajb'enok yet' heb' yinhtilal Manasés, smilalxo heb'. Te ay smay heb' icha junok nok' mam wakax, ma icha yip junok nok' kaltakte'al wakax niwak sch'a'ak. Ol spech masanil chonhab' heb' masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Isacar icha tik: Tzalajanhek hex yinhtilal Zabulón b'ajtak tzex ek'i. Hanhejtona' hex pax tik hex yinhtilal Isacar, tzalajanhek b'ajtak kajan hex.

Tzeyawtejkot masanil heb' heyetisraelal t'a tzalkixtak, tzeyak'an silab' to scha sk'o'ol Jehová. Tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol yet' b'eyumal ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' juntzanh tas te wach' ay t'a stitak ha' chi', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Gad icha tik: Ik'jokab' cha'anh Jehová ix ak'an lewanb'ok slu'um heb' yinhtil Gad. Lajan heb' icha nok' nun choj tz'em kutzan, sjekchitanel sk'ab' yet' sjolom schib'ej. Icha chi' ol yutej heb' yajk'o'ol heb' yinhtil Gad chi'.

Ix sik'kanel lum lum te wach' heb' yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha jun lu'um chi' smoj wal to ha t'a heb' yajal tz'ak'ji lu'um. Ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab' Israel, ha heb' yinhtilal Gad ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yalan scheknab'il Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Dan icha tik: Ha wal heb' yinhtilal Dan tik lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' kelem choj ay t'a Basán sk'e tz'itnajok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Neftalí icha tik: Ha heb' yinhtilal Neftalí tik, wach' yajkan heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, yik heb' yaj lum tz'emk'och t'a sur t'a ha' nhajab', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Aser icha tik: Tzijtumokab' swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, xajanokab' heb' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ochokab' heb' b'eyumal yuj yaceite'al te' olivo ay t'a slu'um.
A'okab' k'e'en hierro yet' k'e'en bronce tzek' k'atan syamnub'alok spuerta'il schonhab' heb'. Tek'anokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Hex Jesurún, malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Diosal. Te ay smay sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh asun ayik sjawi honh skolo'.
Ha Dios aynhejek' ket'ok. T'a masanil tiempo tzonh stanhwej. Ha jantak spoder malaj slajwub', tzonh skol sik'lab'il. Ha Jehová ol ik'anel heb' kajk'o'ol t'a kichanh, ol yalani to ol ko satel heb'.

Ha honh israel yinhtil honh winhaj Jacob tik, junk'olal ol honh ajnhejek' yet' kinhtilal t'a ko lu'um. Te wach' ol aj ixim ko trigo yet' sat te' ko uwa, yujto manh ol och wa'an yak'an nhab' t'a ko lu'um tik.

Hex wetisraelal, te wach' kiko', ¿mach wal junok syal slajb'an sb'a ket'ok? Ha Jehová tzonh kolani, ha tzonh tanhwani, skolwajpax ket'ok. Icha kespada yaj Jehová yik skak'an ganar heb' kajk'o'ol. Ol yak'em sb'a heb' kajk'o'ol chi' t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha t'a spanhanil yol yik Moab ayek' winhaj Moisés chi' ayik ix k'e winh t'a jolom witz Nebo ay t'a sjolom lum niwan witz Pisga, haton lum ay t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ix sch'oxkanb'at masanil lum lum Jehová yil winh: Haton masanil lum Galaad masanto b'aj ay smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan,
lum smakb'en heb' yik Neftalí, heb' yik Efraín, heb' yik Manasés yet' masanil lum yik heb' yik Judá, masanto sk'och lum t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Skot lum t'a Neguev masanto sk'och lum t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán yet' t'a masanil spatiktak Jericó schonhab'il te' palma, masanto sk'och lum t'a Zoar.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Haton jun lu'um tik wak'nak hin ti' wak'an t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob. Walannak t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' heyinhtilal, xin chi, yuj chi' tzin ch'oxkanb'at lum t'ayach, wach'chom manhxo ol hach k'och t'a lu'um, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', hata' ix cham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová chi', t'a yol yik Moab, icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun ch'olan t'a yol yik Moab t'a yichanh Bet-peor ix mukji winh yuj Jehová chi', palta malaj mach ojtannak jun b'aj mukankan sniwanil winh chi'.
120 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh. Wach'to yilan winh, tek'antopax winh ayik ix cham winh chi'.
Jun wal ujal ix och heb' chonhab' israel t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winh chi' t'a tzinan lu'um yik Moab, icha sb'eyb'al heb'.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'kanb'at sk'ab' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yik scha'ankan sjelanil winh yet' yopisio icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Yuj chi' ha heb' chonhab' israel, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winhaj Josué chi'.
Atax t'a jun pekti' chi', manhxa junokxo schekab' Jehová t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel k'elk'umb'a ix aj Jehová ix lolon yet'ok, icha ix aj slolon yet' winhaj Moisés.

Manhxa junokxo mach ix k'ulan tas satub'tak yilji yet' milagro icha sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yol yik Egipto t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' t'a masanil heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och sk'ulan tastak ay smay icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh heb' yetisraelal.
